title: solutions-pro-services-weekly-sync-notes-2026-08-18
content:
Weekly sync notes: Solutions Engineering + Pro Services - 2026-08-18

Attendees:
- Priya Kapoor (owner)
- Ethan Chen (SE)
- Sofia Martinez (Pro Services)
- Daniel Brooks (Infra/Onboarding)
- Maya Patel (Customer Success)
- Joined briefly: Alex R. (SRE)

Agenda:
1) Quick customer updates (status, risks)
2) Blockers needing infra / product support
3) Rollout timelines & canary plan reviews
4) Action items and owners
5) AOB / notes to self

TL;DR:
- AcmeRetail: beta traffic test scheduled 8/24, KV-cache warmup script ready, waiting on Dedicated slot (request SVC-4388).
- FinBank: security review almost done; HSM/KMS integration blocked by legal questions (Confluence notes linked).
- HealthCo: data residency requirements causing small config changes; private deployment PR merged, now validating.
- Multiple small infra asks - Ethan to coordinate with Infra to prioritize Dedicated capacity for AcmeRetail.

Customer updates (detailed):

1) AcmeRetail (ecomm) - contact: tara@acmeretail.com
- Current status: integration tests green on staging; we saw tokenization mismatch on a small product feed sample (SKU descriptions).
- Work done this week: created tokenizer pre-processing shim; added an embedding-normalization step; KV-cache warmup script v0.2 tested locally.
- Outstanding: waiting for dedicated GPU slots (request SVC-4388). Without slot we can only run limited scale tests (will affect 8/24 beta).
- Risks: latency SLA target 120ms p95 may not be met until we get dedicated pool + quantized model variant.
- Related tickets: SVC-4388 (Dedicated capacity request), SVC-4321 (tokenizer mismatch).
- Next steps: Ethan to follow up with Daniel by 8/20 on capacity request; if not approved, plan B is to run canary with degraded throughput and explicit client rate-limiting.

2) FinBank (finance) - contact: nora@finbank.com
- Current status: onboarding checklist at 90%; security review in progress.
- Blocker: legal asked for proof of HSM integration and key lifecycle diagrams - Maya to upload additional docs to Confluence.
- Action: Sofia to run end-to-end encryption test in private env next week (needs HSM sandbox access).
- Notes: we discovered a minor issue with audit log formatting (timestamps in different TZ). Logged as SVC-4410.
- Next steps: Sofia + Priya to meet with Legal on 8/19 to clarify KMS expectations; aim to complete sign-off by 8/26.

3) HealthCo (healthcare) - contact: james@healthco.org
- Current status: Private deployment PR merged into private-deployments repo (PR #1187).
- In progress: validation of data residency routing (EU region) + SOC2 checklist items.
- Blocker: customer asked for an offline air-gapped deployment checklist; we need to confirm on-prem installer size and runbook.
- Next steps: Daniel to produce an air-gap checklist draft by 8/21; Priya to share with customer for initial review.

4) Beta customers / misc:
- Two early PLG trials reported intermittent 503s late last week. SRE traced to autoscaler flapping on CPU pressure; fix deployed but need more metrics retention. Alex to extend logs retention for next 7 days.

Blockers (callouts requiring cross-team help):
- Dedicated capacity approval for AcmeRetail (SVC-4388) - infra / sales coordination needed. Owner: Daniel. Due: 2026-08-20.
- HSM/KMS proof & diagrams for FinBank sign-off. Owner: Maya + Legal. Due: 2026-08-19 meeting.
- Air-gap runbook for HealthCo private deployment. Owner: Daniel. Due: 2026-08-21.
- Tokenizer mismatch root cause analysis for AcmeRetail sample. Owner: Ethan. Due: 2026-08-20.

Decisions made:
- For AcmeRetail, we will target a canary on 8/24 using a dedicated quantized variant if capacity comes through; otherwise fallback to limited-rate canary.
- FinBank security gating: we will not proceed to production until Legal confirms HSM approach - no exceptions.

Action items (short list):
- Ethan: finish tokenizer shim and post repro steps to SVC-4321 (due 8/20).
- Daniel: escalate SVC-4388 to infra director and confirm slot assignment (due 8/20).
- Maya: upload HSM diagrams + KMS lifecycle doc to Confluence and ping Legal (due 8/19).
- Sofia: schedule E2E encrypted-run in private env once HSM sandbox available (target 8/24).
- Priya: update rollout canary plan doc and share with PMs + Sales by 8/21.
- Alex (SRE): increase autoscaler metric retention and monitor for 72h (done by 8/19).

Notes to self / open questions:
- Need clearer SLA language for quantized vs fp16 model variants - product/contract to confirm if we can expose variant-level SLA differences. (Ping product-hosted-api)
- Consider pre-provisioning a small "burst" pool for high-touch customers to avoid last-minute capacity stalls. Worth a quick proposal to infra/finance.
- Follow up on PR #1187 verification results; get test logs from CI job 2243 (artifact linked in PR).

AOB:
- Customer onboarding checklist: consider adding a short "ops smoke test" that runs a 1-min high-QPS burst to validate autoscaler behavior pre-cutover.
- Next weekly sync: 2026-08-25 10:00 PT.

Raw notes / scratch (informal):
- Sasha from Sales asked if we can compress warmup time - maybe pre-warm KV cache during off-peak via low-cost batch job? Explore.
- TODO: add step-by-step for embedding normalization into the onboarding playbook.
- Quick wins: push tokenizer fix to staging, ask Acme to re-export sample feed (strip html).

Meeting adjourned ~40m.

-- Priya
summary: Weekly sync for SE + Pro Services capturing customer integration statuses, blockers (Dedicated capacity, HSM proof, air-gapped runbook), action items and owners. Canary plan for AcmeRetail targeted 8/24 pending infra approval.
